body.name: Cylinder modified-Bartlett HAC delta-method variance
body.construction: \(\widehat\Omega_F=\widehat\Gamma_0+\sum_{k=1}^{h_T}K(k/(h_T+1))(\widehat\Gamma_k+\widehat\Gamma_k^{\mathsf T})\) and \(\widehat v_F=\nabla F(\widehat p_F)^{\mathsf T}\widehat\Omega_F\nabla F(\widehat p_F)\), where \(K(k/(h_T+1))=1-k/(h_T+1)\) for \(1\le k\le h_T\).
